intent: Frozen blocking thresholds and verdict rules for transfer evaluation evidence. The gate reads this policy, not a later working manifest.
pair_rule: every declared semantic pair evaluates both members jointly; one failing member or one missing member fails the pair gate
non_regression_rule: the candidate must not decline against the unchanged comparable baseline on the same case version, metric version, partition, target generation, settings, and repetition policy; a decline fails even when the candidate still exceeds the threshold
missing_error_rule: missing and error rows stay in the denominator and produce incomplete
zero_coverage_rule: a partition with zero applicable rows is zero coverage and produces incomplete, never a pass
applicability_rule: not_applicable requires a predeclared conditional rule with applicable=false and null pass and score
pre_scoring_blockers: missing production prompt reference or hash
either effective completion-token budget other than 1200
either effective enable_thinking value other than the frozen value
normalized product and evaluation request mismatch for any parity fixture
evaluator-only metadata or a provider credential inside target evidence
required_diagnostics: metric, partition, passed, applicable, expected, exact fraction, threshold, and method
zero-coverage and conditional applicability counts with reasons
every missing and error row with its cause
every candidate pass-to-fail case and applicability change
pair id, member, and repetition failures
stateful transition and deterministic expected-versus-actual failures
manifest, hash, budget, thinking-flag, and baseline-comparability failures
links to raw evidence and the non-substitution statement

gate_test_matrix.fixture: all declared rows pass at threshold
missing case, check, metric, or partition result
candidate above threshold but below comparable baseline
incomparable baseline or changed case version
conditional not_applicable with a valid rule
missing shared builder or production prompt hash
product and evaluation normalized request mismatch
either v3 adapter budget differs from 1200
evaluator metadata or provider secret leaks into target evidence
